name: Rider dispute-abuse signal
statement: At least RIDER_ABUSE_MIN_DISPUTES past disputes, of which at least RIDER_ABUSE_REJECT_SHARE_MIN were rejected, together with an existing platform fraud flag of any kind (the reviewer sees the flag detail; in DISP-002 it is for frequent late cancellations), raise FRAUD_SIGNAL against the rider. Per GEN-R03 it never changes the outcome; like any fraud signal it requires human approval whichever party the outcome favors (AUTH-02 trigger 2).
